extracted.intended_audience: prospective improv students (beginners and people seeking confidence, public-speaking or comedy training) in the Los Angeles area
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluative and promotional information for choosing/taking improv classes from a single Los Angeles improv school (Improv-LA), aimed at beginners and professionals seeking confidence, communication skills, or comedy training. Emphasizes outcomes, teaching approach, formats, and practical conveniences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supportive, No-Ego Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Forget auditions, cliques, or competing for stage time. We offer a positive community focused on building you up, not tearing you down, making us the most welcoming alternative to "comedy factories."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a selling/evaluative criterion: look for schools that prioritize a welcoming, non-competitive culture where students are supported rather than judged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-World Skills
rubrics_metrics.description: We include how to use improv class to be better at public speaking, overcoming social anxiety, and talking to people with confidence. Our teachers help you think faster on your feet for work, social settings, and beyond. It's not just fun for a few weeks, but skills that will last long after class ends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes practical transfer of improv skills to everyday life and professional contexts (public speaking, anxiety reduction, faster thinking). Presented as an outcome measure of the curriculum's usefulness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Every Improv Style
rubrics_metrics.description: We’re the only school teaching every improv style using "cheat codes" that save you years of training. Be able to do improv with anyone, from anywhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims comprehensiveness of technique coverage and efficient pedagogy; implies a criterion that a good program should teach multiple styles and offer accelerated learning methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affordable & Student-First
rubrics_metrics.description: Our curriculum puts you first, not our shows. You’ll find your voice, meet friendly people with goals just like you, and have more fun than you ever thought possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames affordability and student-centered priorities as evaluation points — prioritize programs that focus on student growth over revenue/show production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convenient Locations & Parking
rubrics_metrics.description: Convenient improv classes located in Burbank, Silver Lake, and Los Feliz serving the greater Los Angeles area with free and easy parking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical logistic criterion: proximity, multiple locations, and parking availability are highlighted as factors that make classes accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beginner-Friendly / New-to-Improv Welcome
rubrics_metrics.description: NEW TO IMPROV? First-timers or total beginners? You are in the right place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly positions courses as appropriate for true beginners; a criterion for novices is clear messaging that classes accept and support newcomers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes: Confidence, Social Courage, and Making Friends
rubrics_metrics.description: Be confident. Make new friends. Become fearless - both on stage... and in life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights desired learner outcomes (confidence, social ease, community). Useful as metrics for evaluating whether a program delivers personal-growth benefits beyond technical improv skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format Flexibility: Weekly Group Classes and Improv On-Demand
rubrics_metrics.description: WEEKLY GROUP CLASSES — Improv, Comedy Writing, Voice Over, and more! IMPROV ON-DEMAND — Learn at your own pace with our Streaming Course.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program format diversity is presented as a feature: look for both in-person scheduled classes and self-paced/streaming options to suit different learners' schedules and preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate / Business Training Availability
rubrics_metrics.description: BUSINESS — Customized Group Sessions for Fun & Team-Building
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Availability of customized corporate sessions is a criterion for organizations seeking team-building or communication training through improv.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability Beyond Actors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions improv as broadly useful (not limited to performers); evaluative criterion: whether a program tailors lessons to non-actors and everyday applications.
